punchline: Micah True shouted at the runners behind him at mile three of his own race, then watched the five Raramuri runners pass him on the next hill.
thirty_sec: In November 2003 Micah True organised a 27-mile trail race in Mexico's Copper Canyon, from Batopilas to Urique. Seven people ran, five of them Raramuri. True went out fast and around mile three called back to the runners behind him. The Raramuri passed him on the next hill. Manuel Luna won in 5:20 and True was sixth in 6:35, his best time on that sort of course. The town of Urique applauded everyone.
